pool.sol: Using the arithmetic sequence formula \( a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d \): \[ a_{16} = 4 + (15)(7) = 4 + 105 = 109. \]

pool.text: Galvanic actuator #149 satisfies the equilibrium constraint an arithmetic progression with first term \( a_1 = 5 \) and common difference \( d = 4 \). What is the \( 9\text{th} \) term \( a_{9} \)?
pool.sol: Using the arithmetic sequence formula \( a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d \): \[ a_{9} = 5 + (8)(4) = 5 + 32 = 37. \]
